seed_ideas.title: Conductivity-conditioned generation of disordered Li-halide solid electrolytes
seed_ideas.text: Battery crystal discovery, restricted to the disordered Li-halide solid electrolytes where fast Li conduction actually lives. Crystal foundation models: there's hella, but MatterGen's <=20-atom unit-cell limit and stable ordered-crystal training set do not cover the partially-occupied configurations that fast Li conductors need. Fine-tune MatterGen's adapter on predicted ionic conductivity using DTU's 400k-structure halide database as the domain-specific transport label source, generate and screen 1k-100k candidates per arm, NEB-validate the top ten, and compare hit rate against unconditioned generation and ICSD screening, all within the halide family. Compute axis: generated candidate crystal structures screened per arm, 1,000-100,000 candidates, 3 levels.
seed_ideas.compute_open: whether halide-domain fine-tuning shifts the hit-rate gap outside seed noise
seed_ideas.root_question: Battery crystal discovery? Crystal foundation models: there's hella, for battery generation, transport properties are different.
